name: Myanmar
value: Junta claims 11 resistance bases near Bago
summary: Junta says it seized a NUG command and 10 other bases near the Mon–Bago border; no major city has changed hands
state: State media said on 10 Nov that the army seized a NUG special region command and 10 other bases along the Mon state–Bago region border after a six-day operation; the claim could not be independently verified (AP via ABC News). Myanmar Now reported on 11 Nov that the military claims 11 positions taken from PDF, NUG and KNU forces since early November. No major city has changed hands and no new mass-casualty airstrike was confirmed as of 13 Nov, so the signal stays at Watch.
for_you: Civilians in conflict areas face airstrikes and displacement. Travellers should follow FCDO advice, which warns against travel to much of Myanmar. Fighting can disrupt border trade and road links at short notice.
rubric_hit: Watch: civil war at sustained intensity; no major city fallen and no new mass-casualty airstrike confirmed

sources.title: ABC News (AP) — Myanmar army seizes key resistance HQ and bases held by opposition, state media says
Myanmar Now — Myanmar junta seizes NUG Special Military Region and PDF camps

why: A multi-sided civil war affecting 50 million people, with spillover to China, Thailand, India and Bangladesh.
drivers: Resistance offensives, junta airstrikes, Chinese mediation, elections, humanitarian access.

rubric.alert: Major city falls, mass-casualty airstrikes, or cross-border escalation.
